title: Mobile
description: Herb's recently played covers hung as a Calder mobile from one thread — pull a cover and let go, and the arms see-saw in turn before the whole cascade finds its balance again. Tap one and it flies up to the top arm, the sculpture tips under the new weight, and its preview sets the threads humming and the mobile bobbing to the beat.
intent: A physical jukebox: listening order is the balance of the sculpture, so choosing a song is something you feel the whole mobile react to.
